card.name: First digit of a two-digit number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number written as separate digits, such as the 4 in 40°C or the 6 in 60 mCi. It is strongest inside parentheses after a limit like 104°F or a dose cap.

modes.label: Converted limits
modes.description: The leading digit of a metric value in parentheses after a Fahrenheit or MBq value.
modes.example: do not exceed a temperature of 104°F (<<4>>0°C)

modes.label: Other numbers
modes.description: The leading digit of ages, pay amounts, years or table values.
modes.example: individuals who are <<4>>0 years old or older

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the number with a following digit such as 0.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a two-digit number, most often the 4 in 40°C, where another digit is about to follow.
